ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - PurpleSharp Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the PurpleSharp adversary simulation tool

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\purplesharp.*") OR process_original_file_name = "PurpleSharp\.exe") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*xyz123456\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*PurpleSharp.*")))
